question: How did the author make Code OSS 1.132.0 compile and run on Electron 44.2.0, whose clipboard API dropped 13 methods?

electronApiChange.note: Surviving methods also became Promise-based in 44.

scope: Static analysis of compiled main.js. Inlined or renamed helpers may be unrecoverable; absence of a finding is reported, not guessed.
finding: The shipped main.js still references clipboard APIs that Electron 44 removed. Either those code paths are dead, or the carrier bundles a shim. Read the excerpts before concluding.
